senses.gloss: नग- + अग्र नग- + अग्र, n. the summit of a mountain.
नगर- + अधिप नगर- + अधिप, m. chief of the police in a town, Kathās. 5, 49.
नगर- + अधिपति नगर- + अधिपति, m. chief of the police in a town, Kathās. 10, 70.
नाग- + आनन नाग- + आनन, m. a peacock, Pañc. i. d. 175 (perhaps to be changed to नागाशन, i. e. नाग-अशन).
नाग- + केशर नाग- + केशर, m. a tree, Mesua Roxburghii, Wight. Rām. 6, 96, 7.

नाग- + दन्त नाग- + दन्त,
 I. m. 1. ivory, MBh. 12, 3630. 2. a pin projecting from a wall, and used to hang things upon, Pañc. 116, 19.
 II. f. ता, the name of an Apsaras, Rām. 2, 91, 17.
 III. f. ती, a plant, Tiaridium indicum Lehm., Suśr. 1, 138, 12.
नाग- + दन्तक नाग- + दन्तक, m. 1. ivory, Varāh. Bṛh. S. 52, 62. 2. a pin projecting from a wall, and used to hang things upon, Hit. 27, 12.
नाग- + द्वीप नाग- + द्वीप, m. the name of a division of the world, MBh. 6, 251.

नग न-ग,
 I. adj. Immoveable, MBh. 12, 5730 (?).
 II. m.
 1. A mountain, Rām. 6, 83, 1.
 2. A tree, Man. 8, 330.

नाग नाग, i. e. नग + अ, 1. m.
 1. A serpent, especially the name of fabulous serpents, having a human face and inhabiting Pātāla, or the infernal regions, Rām. 2, 25, 30; Man. 1, 37.
 2. An elephant, Rām. 1, 6, 22.
 3. A small tree, Mesua Roxburghii Wight., Suśr. 1, 171, 7.
 4. One of the five vital airs, [] Vedāntas. in Chr. 207, 15.
 5. A proper name, Hariv. 11537.
 6. The name of a mountain, Bhāg. P. 5, 16, 27.
 II. f. गी, A female elephant, Suśr. 1, 178, 1.
 III. adj., f. गी.
 1. Consisting of serpents, MBh. 8, 2586.
 2. Produced from an elephant, Suśr. 1, 194, 1.
 IV. f. गा, A proper name, Rājat. 7, 293.
 --Comp.

नगर नग + र, n. and f. री, A town, Man. 4, 107.
 --Comp.

नागर नागर, i. e. नगर + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Belonging to a town, MBh. 1, 5682; m. A citizen, Rām. 1, 17, 34.
 2. Referring to a town, MBh. 2, 256.
 3. Polite, Śāk. 94, 10 C.
 II. f. री, A crafty woman, Uddhavadūta 16 in Haeb. Anth. 351.
 III. n. Dry ginger, Suśr. 1, 161, 2.
 --Comp.
नगराय नगरय, a denomin. derived from नगर by य, Ātm. To look like a town, MBh. 9, 2162.
नगरीय नगरीय, i. e. नगर + ईय, adj. Belonging to a town, Lass. 75, 19.
नगवन्त् नग + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Abounding in trees, Rām. 5, 9, 6.
नागवन्त् नाग + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Consisting in elephants, MBh. 5, 5703.

नग्न नग्न,
 I. adj., f. ना, Naked, Man. 4, 45.
 II. f. ना, A girl before menstruation, Pañc. iii. d. 217.
 --Cf. Goth. naqvadei; A.S. nacud, nacod, genacian; Lat. nudus.

नग्नक नग्न + क,
 I. m. A naked mendicant, Pañc. 236, 4.
 II. f. निका, A girl before menstruation, Pañc. iii. d. 213.

नग्नजित् नग्न-जि + त्,
 I. m. The name of a prince, MBh. 1, 2439.
नग्नत्व नग्न + त्व, n. Nakedness, Hit. pr. d. 27.
नग-नदी नग-नदी, f. the name of a river.
नागमय नाग + मय, adj., f. यी, Consisting in elephants, Hariv. 9379.
नागरक नागर + क, m. The chief of a town, Śāk. 73, 1, v. r.

नागरिक नागरिक, i. e. नगर + इक,
 I. adj. Inhabiting a town, Sch. ad Śāk. d. 51.
 II. m.
 1. A citizen, Vikr. 77, 12.
 2. Polite, Śāk. 60, 2.
 2. A superintendent of the police, Daśak. 195, 13.
नागिन् नागिन्, i. e. नाग + इन्, adj. Surrounded by serpents, Hariv. 14844.
नाग्नजित नाग्नजित, i. e. नग्नजित् + अ, patronym. f. ती, A descendant of Nagnajit, Bhāg. P. 3, 3, 4.
नाग-नासा नाग-नासा, f. the trunk of an elephant, 5, 22, 2.
नाग- + पाश नाग- + पाश, m. a special kind of noose.
नाग-पुर नाग-पुर, n. a name of Hāstinapura.
नाग- + पुष्प नाग- + पुष्प, m. the name of several plants.
नाग- + बन्धक नाग- + बन्धक, m. an elephant-hunter.
नाग- + बल नाग- + बल, 1. m. a name of Bhīmasena. 2. f. ला, a shrub, Uraria lagopodioides.
नाग- + भोग नाग- + भोग, m. a kind of snake, Rām. 5, 74, 31.
नाग- + मातृ नाग- + मातृ, f. the mother of the serpents, epithet of Surasā, Rām. 5, 6, 2.
नग- + मात्र नग- + मात्र, adj. large as mountains, Arj. 8, 1.
नगर- + मालिन् नगर- + मालिन्, adj. garlanded with cities, Johns. Sel. 4, 19.
नगर- + रक्षा नगर- + रक्ष, f. government of a town, Mṛcch. 148, 5.
नगर-, नगरी- + रक्षिन् नगर-, नगरी- + रक्षिन्, and पुर-, m. the watchman of a town, a policeman, Mṛcch. 140, 17; MBh. 13, 6216; [] Kathās. 13, 169.
नगर-, नगरी- + रक्षिन् नगर-, नगरी- + रक्षिन्, and पुर-, m. the watchman of a town, a policeman, Mṛcch. 140, 17; MBh. 13, 6216; [] Kathās. 13, 169.
नाग- + राज् नाग- + राज्, m. the king of the serpents, Mārk. P. 23, 24.
नाग- + राज नाग- + राज, 1. the king of the serpents, Kathās. 22, 209. 2. a great elephant, MBh. 4, 1679.
नाग- + राजन् नाग- + राजन्, m. (cf. राज), Nal. 14, 3.
नाग- + लता नाग- + लता, f. a proper name, Rājat. 5, 359.
नाग- + वधू नाग- + वधू, f. the female of an elephant, Rām. 2, 65, 24.
नाग-वल्ली̆ नाग-वल्ली̆, f. the betel plant, Piper betel, Śiś. 9, 65.
नाग-वल्ली̆ नाग-वल्ली̆, f. the betel plant, Piper betel, Śiś. 9, 65.
नाग-वीथी नाग-वीथी, f. 1. a line formed by snakes, MBh. 13, 5261. 2. the name of a part of the orbit of the moon, Yājñ. 3, 187. 3. a proper name, Hariv. 148.
